positions.name: QuantumDBMigrationRationale
positions.frame: what grounds the decision to migrate the analytics pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB?
positions.why: src-1 is Dave's direct declarative naming the switch itself; src-2 is his direct assertive giving the quantified rationale (10x performance, lower licensing cost). src-3 and src-4 are the session-level summary bullets that restate exactly those two claims under Dave's voice (footing resolves principal to Dave via the adjacent quote), so they read in the same direction as src-1/src-2 even though they are paraphrase rather than verbatim restatement — kept together as one directional read on 'what justifies this move', holding the tension between raw quote and derived summary rather than resolving it. src-5 (timeline) is left out: it carries no direct quote to restate and is not attributed to Dave's words, so it does not share this rationale-read.
